mapper.select: SELECT id AS provider_id, code, provider_type AS type, credential_ref, priority, enabled, version FROM notification_sms_provider WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{providerId} AND enabled = #{enabled} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification_sms_binding binding WHERE binding.provider_id = notification_sms_provider.id AND binding.route = #{route} AND binding.enabled = TRUE AND binding.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY priority, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_sms_provider (id, code, provider_type, credential_ref, priority, enabled) VALUES (#{providerId}, #{code}, #{providerType}, #{credentialRef}, #{priority}, FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_sms_provider SET code = #{code}, provider_type = #{providerType}, credential_ref = #{credentialRef}, priority = #{priority}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{providerId} AND enabled = FALSE AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE notification_sms_provider provider SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE provider.id = #{providerId} AND provider.enabled = FALSE AND provider.deleted = 0 AND provider.version = #{expectedVersion} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification_sms_binding binding WHERE binding.provider_id = provider.id AND binding.deleted = 0 )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_sms_binding (id, provider_id, notification_code, route, language_tag, sign_name, provider_template_code, parameter_mapping, enabled) VALUES (#{bindingId}, #{providerId}, #{notificationCode}, #{route}, #{languageTag}, #{signName}, #{providerTemplateCode}, CAST(#{parameterMappingJson} AS JSONB), FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_sms_binding SET notification_code = #{notificationCode}, route = #{route}, language_tag = #{languageTag}, sign_name = #{signName}, provider_template_code = #{providerTemplateCode}, parameter_mapping = CAST(#{parameterMappingJson} AS JSONB), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{bindingId} AND enabled = FALSE AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{expectedVersion}
